battleTraits.name: Eye of the Gods
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is either contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent and not in combat, or destroyed an enemy unit this turn.
battleTraits.effect: Roll once on the Eye of the Gods table; the unit gains the matching passive ability for the rest of the battle (kept alongside earlier rolls; duplicates are not cumulative). 1: no effect. 2: Ward (6+). 3: +1 to run rolls. 4: -1 to wound rolls for attacks targeting this unit. 5: +1 Rend to melee weapons. 6: pick any ability from the table.
battleTraits.timingText: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn

regimentAbilities.name: The Dread Banner
regimentAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly Chaos Warriors or Chaos Knights unit.
regimentAbilities.effect: You can immediately roll on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit.
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round

regimentAbilities.name: Fierce Conquerors
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Chaos Warriors units.

enhancements.name: Mark of Khorne
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons if they charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Mark of Tzeentch
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield (not your general).
enhancements.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units. It cannot use Move abilities for the rest of the phase.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

enhancements.name: Mark of Nurgle
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target your general.

abilities.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, you can roll on the Eye of the Gods table for this unit.

abilities.name: Iron-Willed Champion
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit (not this unit) to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.

abilities.name: Swift Death
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Bringers of Desolation
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Impaling Charge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Cursed Lances if it charged in the same turn.
